items.question: Who can attend?
items.answer: Any adult age 18 or older is welcome. We do not ask for identification, documents or payment. You belong here. Thursday daytime classes are for women only.

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes. Classes and textbooks are completely free.

items.question: Can I join in the middle of the semester?
items.answer: Yes. Registration stays open all semester, so you can start any week.

items.question: Can I get a ride?
items.answer: We may be able to give rides to groups of two or more. Rides are limited, and students who plan to come every week get first priority.

items.question: Is there childcare?
items.answer: Limited childcare is available during Thursday daytime classes for children ages 0–6. Spaces can fill up. When they do, we keep a waiting list.
